Uses inventory_has because mining cobblestone_wall with a pickaxe drops the cobblestone_wall item into the player's inventory. The player starts with a wooden pickaxe which is sufficient to mine cobblestone walls. This directly confirms the player has mined at least one wall block.

The iron ingots are obtained from chests behind the cobblestone wall. The recipe yields 3 iron doors, so checking for min_count=1 is sufficient.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a spruce_button (from 1 spruce plank at the crafting table) places the resulting spruce_button into the player's inventory. The spruce planks are obtained from the chest adjacent to the cyan concrete pillar. The recipe yields 1 button per plank.
